$comment: The hash of the files install-merge-driver.mjs copies into the git common directory, per DRIVER_VERSION (beads-merge-driver.mjs). The installer replaces an equal version and keeps a higher one, so a changed file under an old version would be overwritten by an older checkout's prepare in every worktree. beads-merge.test.mjs fails until a change to those files comes with a new version and its hash here. Add a row; never edit an existing one. Spec: docs/specs/beads-merge-driver.spec.md.
